query:
INSERT INTO filter_rules
                 (account_id, position, enabled, folder_id, feed_id, field, match, pattern, action)
             SELECT $1, coalesce(max(position), 0) + 1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8
             FROM filter_rules WHERE account_id = $1
             HAVING count(*) < $9
             RETURNING id
